subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive Gateway v4 response-envelope field for this bug fix?
rationale: The code change is narrow and proven, but the public protocol envelope is compatibility-sensitive because older strict generated clients may reject unknown top-level response fields.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
options.body: Rebase the PR, rerun exact-head checks, and land the narrow fix with the documented compatibility expectation that v4 clients tolerate optional response metadata.

options.title: Require version-gated metadata
options.body: Ask for a protocol-version or capability-gated variant if maintainers do not want new top-level v4 response fields to appear unconditionally.

options.title: Pause for a different contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR if metadata should move into method payloads or another non-envelope contract instead.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, rerun exact-head checks, and land the narrow fix with the documented compatibility expectation that v4 clients tolerate optional response metadata.
